gloss: cutting in line; jumping the queue

definitions.gloss: cutting in line; jumping the queue
definitions.explanation: entering a line from the side without waiting one's turn

examples.japanese: {横入|よこい}り⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{横入|よこい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧がいて⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I got angry because someone cut into the line.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{横入|よこい}り⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I cut into the line at the ramen shop, the person behind me called me out.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (side, lateral) + {入|い}り (entering). Describes the act of entering a queue from the side rather than joining at the end. Considered rude behavior in Japan, where orderly queuing is a strong social norm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横入|よこい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cut in line
- {横入|よこい}り⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to have someone cut in front of you
- {横入|よこい}り⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no cutting in line
- ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{横入|よこい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cut into a line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{割|わ}り{込|こ}み→割り込む：06973_warikomu⟧: cutting in — similar meaning, also used for interrupting conversations or traffic
- ⟦{割|わ}り{込|こ}む→割り込む：06973_warikomu⟧: to cut in — verb form; broader usage including cutting into traffic
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to wait one's turn — the expected behavior

NOTE: {横入|よこい}り is particularly common in children's speech and in casual contexts. Adults more often use ⟦{割|わ}り{込|こ}み→割り込む：06973_warikomu⟧.
